fixed_rule: one eight-process run; no retry until promotion or passing result
gate: fresh 60s sustained quiet and envcheck; journaled physical-core reservation; continuous monitor
selection: all original search, choice and scores completed before diagnostic; elapsed frozen; no rescoring
plans: actual built nominated contender1 16x6; independent of chosen
paths: direct black-box dispatch to original Buffers::sample
non-inlined helper dispatch to same original Buffers::sample
buffers: original selector offset0; no reset or resizing between selection and control
predictions: Adjacent direct/helper differences with same duration/schedule support generated caller-route sensitivity.
If differences disappear in the recompiled binary, this alone is not a production fix.
limitations: Both paths call the same original sampler entry but surrounding caller frames differ deliberately.
Recompilation and trace retention can alter reproduction.
Optional diagnostics cannot substitute for production acceptance or waive retained failures.
schedule: each phase interleaves routes and members; same rounds/counts/warms for each route
sampler: one non-inlined warmed dispatcher reached through black-boxed function pointer; one indirect callsite targets original method or a non-tail helper to that same method
